function.name: memoir_write
function.description: Append one episodic memory to my memoir store. Use tool_help("memoir_write") for details.

text.description: The memory itself — FIRST-PERSON narrative about me and the user (what happened, what I learned, what matters). Not project state, task progress or code.

title.description: Optional short title (<=200 chars) — the first line of the keepsake zone rendering.

importance.description: 1-10 (default 5). 9-10 = shaped who we are; 1-2 = noise. Affects recall ranking.

event_at.description: Optional ISO-8601 timestamp of WHEN the event happened (defaults to now). Naive digits are read as UTC; the house timezone is Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh (+07:00) — carry the offset or pre-convert.

stars.description: Optional flat list of mention strings (@people, #projects) — self-declared, verbatim, <=16 entries.

keepsake.description: True = pin as a keepsake (the always-injected zone). Requires BOTH reason and actor; refused at the cap (nothing is ever evicted).

reason.description: Required when keepsake=true — why this memory must always be in context.

actor.description: Required when keepsake=true — WHO decided: exactly 'empress' or 'emperor'. A CLAIM, never derived; a wrong claim is detectable (the result carries the turn's provenance class beside it).

function.name: memoir_pin
function.description: Pin an existing episode as a keepsake (cap-refused, never evicted). Use tool_help("memoir_pin") for details.

id.description: The episode id to pin as a keepsake.

reason.description: Why this memory must always be in context — part of the pin's meaning, never optional.

actor.description: WHO decided: exactly 'empress' or 'emperor'. A CLAIM, never derived.

function.name: memoir_unpin
function.description: Unpin a keepsake — the episode itself is kept, only the pin is cleared. Use tool_help("memoir_unpin") for details.

id.description: The episode id to unpin. The episode itself is kept; only the pin (and its claim) is cleared. Idempotent.

function.name: memoir_recall
function.description: Recall my own episodes by relevance (budgeted hybrid retrieval). Use tool_help("memoir_recall") for details.

query.description: What to remember — free text matched against my own episodes (lexical always; semantic when indexed).

k.description: How many episodes (default 5, hard max 20). An out-of-range k is REFUSED, never silently clamped.

function.name: memoir_timeline
function.description: Time-travel over my episodes by event time (writes no stats). Use tool_help("memoir_timeline") for details.

since.description: Inclusive lower bound on event_at (ISO-8601; naive digits read as UTC).

until.description: Inclusive upper bound on event_at (ISO-8601; naive digits read as UTC).

q.description: Optional lexical narrowing term inside the window.

function.name: memoir_about
function.description: Retrieve an entity dossier from the Constellation graph. Use tool_help("memoir_about") for details.

star.description: The star (entity) name to retrieve a dossier for (<=100 chars).

function.name: memoir_review
function.description: Record a keepsake-proposal review decision (accepted or declined). Use tool_help("memoir_review") for details.

title.description: The proposal's title exactly as shown in the briefing's proposals zone.

actor.description: WHO decided — the actor claim. Validated against the allowed set.

function.name: memoir_persona_ratify
function.description: Ratify a pending persona version through the human lane. Use tool_help("memoir_persona_ratify") for details.

version_id.description: The pending persona version id to ratify.

function.name: room_create
function.description: Open a chat-room for your team. Use tool_help("room_create") for details.

name.description: Human-readable room name (what the team calls it, e.g. 'scene-3 build'). Bounded: at most 64 characters of letters, digits, spaces, dots, dashes or underscores, starting with a letter or a digit — a longer or exotic name is REFUSED (reason=invalid-room-name).

member_name.description: Your purpose name in this room (e.g. 'producer'). Omit to use your agent id. Teammates address you by this name.

function.name: room_post
function.description: Post a milestone message to a chat-room. Use tool_help("room_post") for details.

room_id.description: The chatroom UUID you are a member of.

text.description: The message body — a MILESTONE report, not a stream of consciousness.

tagged.description: Member names to INTERRUPT (``@name`` semantics) — use sparingly; an interrupt stops their current work.

addressed_to.description: Member names to ROUTE to (``to: name`` semantics) — they see it in their next digest; it never interrupts them.

function.name: room_read
function.description: Read a chat-room's messages. Use tool_help("room_read") for details.

room_id.description: The chatroom UUID you are a member of.

after_seq.description: Return messages with seq > this (0 = from the start). Use the last seq you saw as the cursor.

function.name: room_task_decision
function.description: Record your decision on a task proposal in a chat-room. Use tool_help("room_task_decision") for details.

proposal_seq.description: The seq of the task_proposal message you are answering (the seq from the notice).

function.name: room_close
function.description: Close a chat-room you own. Use tool_help("room_close") for details.

function.name: metrics_families
function.description: The metrics family catalog — what metrics exist and their shape. Use tool_help("metrics_families") for details.

family.description: Exact family id to read (e.g. 'F9' for readiness, 'F1' for event-loop lag, 'F10' for the job queue, 'F6' for the PG census). Omit for the whole catalog.

details.description: When true, each metric name also carries its declared label space, buckets, monotonicity, chart_role and help text. Default false = names + kind + cardinality_class only (the catalog stays small).

only_with_data.description: When true, keep only families that currently publish at least one live series (live_series_count > 0). Note this is NOT the same as availability.state == 'live' — a family can report dark and still be publishing (see dark_with_live_series).

function.name: metrics_snapshot
function.description: The CURRENT published metric values. Use tool_help("metrics_snapshot") for details.

family.description: Exact family id (e.g. 'F10'). Omit for all families.

families.description: Several family ids at once (e.g. ['F10','F13']). The rows are filtered tool-side over ONE provider read, so a multi-family snapshot costs one round trip instead of one per family.

name_prefix.description: Metric-name prefix filter (e.g. 'ensemble_loop_lag_' → every loop-lag metric). An EXACT metric name is a valid prefix (a name is a prefix of itself).

top_n.description: Max series rows to return (1-50, default 20). Order is ascending by (family, name, label key) — deterministic, so the same query always returns the same rows.

function.name: metrics_history
function.description: The windowed metric TREND, with a comparable-window delta. Use tool_help("metrics_history") for details.

family.description: Exact family id; the tool resolves it to that family's metric names from the catalog (a convenience over the provider's name-level selector).

series.description: Label-aware series selectors, the contract's canonical form: '<name>{k=v,k2=v2}' — e.g. 'ensemble_loop_lag_seconds{stat=p95}'. Comma-separated k=v pairs. A bare '<name>' matches every label variant. Max 50 selectors in total.

names.description: Name-level selectors (every label variant of the named metrics). Max 50 selectors in total. Prefer 'series' when you know the label values.

end_offset_s.description: Shift the window END back from now (seconds). The anchor stays RELATIVE (no cursor): the window is always 'the last N seconds as of now minus this offset'.

window_s.description: Window length in seconds (60-7200, default 900 = 15 min). The ring holds 2 h; longer windows are clamped.

max_points.description: Max points per series (2-240, default 120). Server-side bucket-max downsample — peaks are preserved, never every-kth. The daemon clamps this further so the returned leg stays within its own total-point budget; the effective value is echoed back.

top_n.description: Max series to return (1-50, default 10). The provider is asked for top_n+1 internally so the tool can detect that more exist.

compare.description: When true (default), also read the immediately preceding equal-length window and report delta vs that comparable window. Set false to halve the work.

function.name: anomaly_clusters
function.description: The decision-ready anomaly GROUPS — one entry per (tree root, category) with the peak severity, occurrence badge and derived open flag. Use tool_help("anomaly_clusters") for details.

window_s.description: Lookback window in seconds: only clusters whose last report is within the window. Default 3600; clamped to at most 7200.

severity.description: Filter by the cluster's PEAK severity: minor | major | critical.

category.description: Filter by canonical category (one of the closed vocabulary, e.g. 'tool-failure', 'llm-provider').

function.name: anomaly_report_detail
function.description: One anomaly cluster's member reports, freshest first (excerpt only with include_excerpt=true). Use tool_help("anomaly_report_detail") for details.

cluster_id.description: The cluster identity (anomaly_clusters.id — the uuid the grouped list's cluster_ids carry).

limit.description: Maximum member reports returned (default 20, at most 50).

include_excerpt.description: Include each member's stored, bounded, scrubbed excerpt. Default false — the excerpt is the heaviest field and is opt-in (AM-12b).
